QuestionStmt.S: The radius of the base of a cone is increasing at the rate 3 cm/minute and the altitude is decreasing at the rate 4 cm/minute. The rate at which the lateral surface area is changing, when the radius is 7 cm and altitude is 24 cm is

Solution.S:
Given:
$$\frac{dr}{dt} = 3 \text{ cm/min}, \quad \frac{dh}{dt} = -4 \text{ cm/min}$$
$$r = 7 \text{ cm}, \quad h = 24 \text{ cm}$$

Lateral surface area of cone:
$$A = \pi r \sqrt{r^2 + h^2}$$

Differentiate with respect to $t$:
$$\frac{dA}{dt} = \pi \left[ r \cdot \frac{d}{dt}\left(\sqrt{r^2 + h^2}\right) + \sqrt{r^2 + h^2} \cdot \frac{dr}{dt} \right]$$

$$= \pi \left[ r \cdot \frac{1}{2\sqrt{r^2 + h^2}} \left( 2r\frac{dr}{dt} + 2h\frac{dh}{dt} \right) + \sqrt{r^2 + h^2} \cdot \frac{dr}{dt} \right]$$

Substitute the values:
$$= \pi \left[ 7 \times \frac{1}{2\sqrt{7^2 + 24^2}} \times \left( 2 \times 7 \times 3 + 2 \times 24 \times (-4) \right) + \sqrt{7^2 + 24^2} \times 3 \right]$$

$$= \pi \left[ 7 \times \frac{1}{2 \times 25} \times (42 - 192) + 25 \times 3 \right]$$

$$= \pi \left[ 7 \times \frac{1}{50} \times (-150) + 75 \right]$$

$$= \pi \left[ -21 + 75 \right]$$

$$\frac{dA}{dt} = 54\pi \text{ cm}^2/\text{min}$$

Final Answer: $$\boxed{54\pi \text{ cm}^2/\text{minute}}$$

Hence, the correct option is D.
